lecons.html:
Soul care, or helping relationship, is a spiritual activity that makes it possible to discover and settle spiritual problems by the Word of God and prayer. It is an activity for administering spiritual and emotional healing to yourself or to others.

Every human being is a spirit, who has a soul and who lives in a body (1 Thess 5:23). The day we come to Christ, we are regenerated (renewed) entirely in our spirit. “Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.” (2 Cor 5:17). “That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.” (John 3:6). The spirit of the repentant person is thus born again and receives an immediate and complete transformation.

The soul still has to go through a process of renewal (Rom 12:2). This is the salvation of the soul (James 1:21). It frees the soul from a number of things that trouble it and keep the person’s will from taking root in faith in the Word of God.

These are all the things the soul was exposed to from the person’s conception. They are rejections, betrayals, abandonments, abuses, humiliations, injustices, and their consequences: inferiority complex, fear, doubt, bitterness, rage, desire for revenge, hatred, and so on. There are also the soul ties created by sin in all its forms, and particularly by illicit intimate relationships. In addition, there are the spiritual ties developed through the occult and those inherited from the family or the nation of origin.

If this spiritual activity of cleansing and strengthening is not done in a person, they will always be dragged by the state of their soul to follow the passions of their body, which through the senses is subject to the influence of the world and the devil. This kind of Christian will always live in the mire of the works of the flesh. “Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness, idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies, envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit God’s Kingdom.” (Gal 5:19-21).

“But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith, gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.” (Gal 5:22-23).

These fruits that come from the Holy Spirit are the products of the renewed human spirit. They must show in the Christian through the soul, to be expressed in the visible world so that people see them and glorify God. Then the word of Christ will be effective in this Christian. “Even so, let your light shine before men; that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father who is in heaven.” (Matt 5:16).

So we must put order into the chaos of the soul. This does not mean that all of a sudden the person would be finished with the works of the flesh and would produce the fruits of the Holy Spirit. But the work of cleansing the soul allows the Christian to be more effective in their walk with God.

Soul care is done once and for all. We do not need to break covenants a thousand times. We do not need to cast out the same demons again and again. Some prayer requests repeated in churches are a source of confusion. If you renounce covenants with idols once, you do not have to go back to them. You can declare that it is done, but you will not start breaking them again. (That said, if you have a sense in your spirit that a tie persists, pray and ask the Holy Spirit to enlighten you so that you can go back to it and break it once and for all. Also, giving in to certain sinful habits can renew ties that must be broken again. But everything must be done with discernment and not just out of supposition and fear.)

Also, if you know with conviction that you are already freed from all the spiritual ties and weaknesses coming from your past life, your family (line) and your former relationships, you should not waste time answering the questions that follow, still less saying the prayers and declarations that come after.

This spiritual activity is recommended for the newborn in Christ and for backsliders who find the way of salvation again. But it may be that after 50 years of life in Christ, a person needs to do this activity because they have not done it since and find that their progress in Christ leaves something to be desired.

Now that you know what you have to do, you are going to get started. Answer the following questions sincerely. You can research your past by consulting older people in your family and in the history of your nation (ethnic group). Do not worry about what you cannot discover; leave it to God. Just make sure you have done your best.

The purpose of this lesson is to lead you to discover for yourself the internal spiritual problems you are dragging along, to understand their extent, and to use God’s defensive and offensive weapons to disconnect from these sources of trouble.

  • Read the following verses in your Bible. Make an effort to commit these texts to memory. The word of God is true. (John 8:36, Gal 3:13-14, 1 Pet 2:9-10, Col 1:12-14)
  • Then read and calmly answer the questions in a notebook that you have bought specially for this exercise
  • Reread your answers
  • Draw the necessary conclusions (I am bound by… to such an extent, etc.)
  • Say the prayers given, using your answers
  • Pray as your spirit is led
  • Do not be afraid. The devil cannot resist you. The Bible says that since you submit to God and resist the devil, he will flee from you (James 4:7). So pray with faith
  • When you finish, you can burn the notebook in which you wrote your answers. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new

General — the covering prayer

Everything begins with the covering prayer: it prepares the spiritual ground for all the work that follows. We do not skip this step.

Generational ties

Generational ties are weaknesses, sins, moral failings, and chaotic life situations that one has mysteriously inherited from parents, grandparents, and so on.

Occult ties

The occult is the search for hidden knowledge. It is forbidden by God. It is also the worship of the creature instead of the Creator. This is called idolatry. Whoever practices the occult gives themselves to covenants with demons. These covenants can be direct (voluntary) or indirect (involuntary). Whoever practices the occult opens themselves to demonic possession.

Ties of bitterness

Bitterness is an emotional wound that shows itself as inner anger and a desire for revenge against people who have offended us. These people may be family members, colleagues or classmates, members of the same church, neighbors, or even the country (its institutions and their leaders). Their wrongdoing may range from simple omission to serious actions, including careless words. It may even be that you were not the target of the wrong, but the shock of what was done to someone else left you traumatized.

Sexual ties

Sexual ties are evil (diabolical) ties in a person’s life through illicit sexual relations: incest, fornication, adultery, and so on.

Ties of rebellion

Ties of rebellion are assaults that the devil launches against a life because of its resistance to its authorities at various levels. On this earth, there are four authorities over every person, and one more for women. The guardian (father, mother or tutor), the boss or teacher, the pastor or priest, the government. A woman is in addition subject to the authority of her husband.

Tie of fear

There is a fear that is normal. It lets us be alert and take action against real dangers. Abnormal fear is an irrational, artificial dread created by the devil and his demons to trouble us and keep us in slavery. This fear that comes from the devil takes two forms. Fear of people drives us to want to please people at the expense of our own emotional balance. Any submission that destroys you is slavery to man and is against the will of God. Fear of misfortune and death is fed by negative thoughts.

Love of the world

Love of the world is enmity against God. Whoever is an enemy of God is under his curse and therefore doomed to failure or to powerful, repeated misfortunes within an apparent success. The Christian who is bound by love of the world will end badly. The 3 great traits of love of the world are the lust of the flesh (the pursuit of fleshly satisfaction of every kind at any cost), the lust of the eyes (desire for material and financial possessions at any cost), the pride of life (the pursuit of position, fame, honor and the glory of men at any cost) (1 John 2:15-17). These things show themselves through the works of the flesh, which are: theft, quarrels, lies, fights, complaints, criticism, covetousness or envy, slander, insults, laziness, hatred of others, anger, alcohol, love of money, malice toward others, fornication, masturbation, pornography, adultery, pride, contempt for others, and so on.

These eight areas are worked through one by one in the exercises of this module, with their questions and prayers.

objectifs: You are cleansed of the ties that held you in chains.
You have forgiven concretely — not just said the words, but taken the step before God.
You have broken with the covenants and ties of the past once and for all.
You can move toward your destiny without being pulled back by what was.

qcm.q: According to the module, what happens to the spirit of the one who comes to Christ?
c: It is regenerated, renewed entirely and immediately
qcm.e: 2 Corinthians 5:17: he is a new creation. The soul, for its part, must go through a process of renewal.

qcm.q: What does the module say about how many times soul care is done?
c: It is done once and for all
It must be redone every month
It is done only in a group
qcm.e: We do not need to break the same covenants a thousand times. Only discernment, not fear, justifies going back to it if a tie persists.

qcm.q: For whom is this spiritual activity recommended?
c: For the newborn in Christ, for backsliders who return, and even for someone who has never done it after many years in Christ
For no one: it is optional for everyone
qcm.e: Even after 50 years of life in Christ, you may need it if you have never done it.

qcm.q: What should you do if you know with conviction that you are already freed from all these ties?
c: Not waste time answering the questions or saying the prayers
Say all the prayers anyway, three times
qcm.e: But this conviction must be sincere and real, not a mere supposition.

qcm.q: According to James 4:7, what does the devil do when we submit to God and resist him?
c: He disappears forever without our having to do anything
qcm.e: “Be subject therefore to God. But resist the devil, and he will flee from you.”

qcm.q: What can the person do with the notebook where they wrote their answers, once the prayers are finished?
c: Give it to their pastor to keep
Keep it to reread every year
They can burn it: the old things have passed away
Show it to their friends as a testimony
qcm.e: 2 Corinthians 5:17: the old things have passed away, all things have become new.

qcm.q: What does all the cleansing work on the eight areas begin with?
c: The covering prayer, which we do not skip
qcm.e: The covering prayer prepares the spiritual ground for all the work that follows.

qcm.q: How does the module define generational ties?
c: Weaknesses, sins, moral failings and chaotic situations mysteriously inherited from parents, grandparents, etc.
qcm.e: They are negative inheritances received from the family line.

qcm.q: What is the occult, according to the module?
c: A harmless curiosity with no consequences
The search for hidden knowledge, forbidden by God, and a form of idolatry
qcm.e: Whoever practices it gives themselves to covenants with demons, direct (voluntary) or indirect (involuntary).

qcm.q: How does the module describe bitterness?
c: An emotional wound: inner anger and a desire for revenge against those who offended us
qcm.e: It can be aimed at family members, colleagues, church brothers and sisters, neighbors or even the country’s authorities.

qcm.q: What are sexual ties, according to the module?
c: Any deep friendship between two people
Ties created by illicit sexual relations: incest, fornication, adultery
The ties of a marriage blessed by God
qcm.e: These relations create soul ties that must be broken through prayer.

qcm.q: Which authorities are concerned by ties of rebellion?
c: The guardian (father, mother, tutor), the boss or teacher, the pastor or priest, the government — and the husband for a wife
qcm.e: Rebellion against these authorities opens the door to assaults from the devil.

qcm.q: What are the two forms of abnormal fear?
c: Fear of God and fear of the devil
Fear of the dark and fear of animals
Fear of people and fear of misfortune and death
Fear of failure and fear of success
qcm.e: The first drives us to please people at the expense of our balance; the second is fed by negative thoughts.

qcm.q: What are the three great traits of love of the world (1 John 2:15-17)?
c: The lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes and the pride of life
qcm.e: “Love of the world is enmity against God”: the Christian who stays bound by it will end badly.

exercices.consigne: This notebook is not a notebook of theory: it is a notebook of action. Every question, every declaration, every prayer must be done, without skipping any. You can take several days to complete everything.
exercices.intro_html:
First read in your Bible: John 8:36 · Galatians 3:13-14 · 1 Peter 2:9-10 · Colossians 1:12-14.

• Answer all the questions in this notebook sincerely. Take as much time as you need.

• Say each prayer aloud, using your answers. Tick the box after each prayer.

• Do not be afraid. The devil cannot resist you when you are submitted to God (James 4:7).

• When you have finished all the sections, reread everything. Soul care is done once and for all.

• You may burn this notebook if you wish — or keep it as a testimony. The old things have passed away.

If this work brings up a pain that is too strong, do not stay alone: call your trainer or an ABBA counseling agent.

exercices.titre: My covering and my identity in Christ
exercices.consigne: Before answering the slightest question about your past, take the time to look at who you are in Christ and what God has already done for you. What the Word of God says about you is the reality; the events you have gone through are facts. The two do not weigh the same.
exercices.intro_html:
The covering prayer

To be done aloud. Take your time: this prayer gives you firm footing before you look at your past.

I confess that Jesus Christ is my Savior. He died for me on the cross and rose on the third day for my justification. Through Christ, I am justified, forgiven, saved and delivered from the kingdom of darkness. I am a child of God through Jesus Christ my Savior. Jesus Christ chose me and I belong to him. He is my Lord and my only Lord.

I cover myself with the blood of Jesus Christ. This blood cleanses me from all sin, washes my conscience from dead works, speaks in my favor and gives me victory over the devil.

“I will not die, but live, and declare Yah’s works. Yah has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.” (Ps 118:17-18)

What God has already done for me

The punishment I should have suffered, I did not suffer, and I will not suffer. The punishment that brings me peace fell on Jesus Christ, and it is by his stripes that I am healed (Isa 53:5; 1 Pet 2:24). Healed spiritually, physically, financially, in every area of my life.

I am saved. Jesus Christ is eternal life, and he gives it to me. I have eternal life in me, now, and I live this life (John 3:36; 1 John 5:11-12).

Christ redeemed me from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for me (Gal 3:13). No curse has any more right over my life.

God rescued me from the power of darkness and transferred me into the kingdom of his beloved Son. In him I have redemption, the forgiveness of my sins (Col 1:13-14).

There is no longer any condemnation for me, because I am in Christ Jesus (Rom 8:1). Justified by faith, I have peace with God (Rom 5:1).

Who I am in Christ

I am born of God. Because I believed in his name, I received the right to become a child of God (John 1:12-13).

I am a new creation: the old things have passed away, behold, all things have become new (2 Cor 5:17).

I am no longer a slave, I am a son (daughter) of God. And if I am a child, I am also an heir of God and a joint heir with Christ (Gal 4:6-7; Rom 8:15-17).

I am of a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, to proclaim the excellencies of him who called me out of darkness into his marvelous light (1 Pet 2:9).

I am his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand so that I would walk in them (Eph 2:10).

I am loved. Nothing will be able to separate me from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus (Rom 8:38-39).

What I have already received

God has blessed me with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ (Eph 1:3).

His divine power has given me everything that pertains to life and godliness (2 Pet 1:3).

The Holy Spirit lives in me: he is the seal of my belonging to God (Eph 1:13-14). He who is in me is greater than he who is in the world (1 John 4:4).

God did not give me a spirit of fear, but of power, love and a sound mind (2 Tim 1:7).

Christ lives in me (Gal 2:20). The Son has set me free: I am truly free (John 8:36).

My assurance for what is coming

If God is for me, who can be against me? (Rom 8:31). I am more than a conqueror through him who loved me (Rom 8:37).

He who began this good work in me will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ (Phil 1:6).

I am not entering this work to drown in pain, fear or worry. I am entering it to be freed from what holds me back. I look at my past with the Lord at my side, and what I am going to discover changes nothing of what God has already done for me.

Lord, I thank you. Lead me by your Holy Spirit through the questions that follow (John 16:13). In the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.

exercices.consigne: These questions are about your identity: your name, your clan, your birth, your family. Answer in your personal notebook, analyze your answers, then say the identity prayer.
exercices.intro_html:
The questions

Answer in your personal notebook, before God alone. Nothing you write is saved in the application.

1. Full name

2. Religion of origin

3. Place and date of birth

4. Clan or tribe names. Do these names have particular meanings?

5. Are you from a polygamous family? What is your mother’s rank? What rank do you hold in the family?

6. What events have marked you most in your life? (Dreams · Attacks · Insults · Shocks)

7. What particular event accompanied your birth?

8. Have you tried to commit suicide?

Before praying: analyze your answers

Take your notebook and reread what you have just written in this section. Do not move on to the prayer before doing this work. Answer in writing:

1. What are the facts? What you really went through: the events, what happened, who did what.

2. What does all this tell you, bluntly, about what you are still carrying?

3. What do you feel when you think back on these facts: fear, mixed feelings, doubts, difficulty believing the Word of God?

4. What does the Word of God say on these points? Go back to what you declared in the identity prayer (exercise “My covering and my identity in Christ”): that is the reality.

5. Your conclusion: write in a few sentences what you discovered and what you want to settle once and for all.

Then pray from this conclusion. Do not just repeat the sentences of the prayer: name precisely what you discovered, and settle it with the Lord, once and for all.

The identity prayer

To be done aloud, using what you wrote about your names, your clan, your birth, your family and the events that marked you.

The blood of Jesus Christ is my plea. I refute all accusations from the world of darkness. I declare myself free from every claim of the kingdom of darkness. The blood of Jesus Christ is my plea.

I cancel, by the blood of Jesus Christ and by the living Word of God who regenerated me, every identity imposed on me by the names I bear. I declare that I am not what these names say, but I am what the Word of God says.

I renounce the identity attached to each of my names: (name each of your names and first names, your clan or tribe names, and what they mean). I am not what these names say.

I renounce every word, every destiny and every curse spoken over my birth or linked to it: (name them, and the event that accompanied your birth).

I renounce every label linked to my rank in my family and to my mother’s situation: (name them).

I free myself from the grip of these events that marked me: (name them). They are part of my story, they are not my identity.

I am in Christ. My identity is in Christ. I am a child of God. I am blessed, I am sanctified, I am glorified, I am more than a conqueror.

Consequently, I declare that I am completely out of the darkness. I am in the light. For this, I give thanks to the Father, who has made me able to share in the inheritance of the saints in the light, who delivered me from the power of darkness and transferred me into the kingdom of the Son of his love, in whom we have redemption, the forgiveness of sins. (Colossians 1:12-14)

The prayer

To be done aloud, using your answers.

Let every evil inheritance in my blood be purged by the blood of Jesus Christ.

I renounce the covenants of my forefathers.

Let all curses inherited from parents and grandparents be broken off me in the name of Jesus Christ.

God has blessed me with every kind of spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ. By the presence of this blessing, I make null and void every curse of my family and nation over me.

I put an end to all the effects of these curses in my life in the name of Jesus Christ.

Let all the problems I am dragging around because of the effects of these curses stop immediately.

I command the reversal of my life situation according to the blessing of God in the name of Jesus Christ.

I renounce these family religions (name them). I have come out of these religions and I break all spiritual ties connecting me to them in the name of Jesus Christ.

I renounce every evil inheritance (name the things you copied from the list, and those you added).

I cover with the blood of Jesus Christ my father, my mother, and other relatives, and all my brothers and sisters.

I wash in the blood of Jesus Christ the material goods I inherited from my parents and forefathers (name them: land, house, jewelry, etc.).

I reject the bad characteristics of my forefathers and parents: (name these characteristics that you see in yourself).

I come out of every rivalry established by my forefathers and parents in the name of Jesus Christ. I refuse to hold any person as an enemy.

I declare that I belong to Christ and I am an heir of God according to the promise. All is well with me and all will always be well in the name of Jesus Christ.

exercices.consigne: Two parts: bitterness against people (A), then bitterness against God (B). Say each prayer aloud and tick each one.
exercices.intro_html:
A. Bitterness against people

Bitterness is an emotional wound that shows itself as inner anger and a desire for revenge against people who have offended us.

List the people who hurt you and describe their wrongdoing

Answer in your personal notebook, before God alone. Nothing you write is saved in the application.

1. Family member — Who? What did they do to you? How did it affect you?

2. School friend or classmate — Who? What did they do to you? How did it affect you?

3. Colleague or coworker — Who? What did they do to you? How did it affect you?

4. Church brother or sister — Who? What did they do to you? How did it affect you?

5. Neighbor — Who? What did they do to you?

6. Do you have bitter feelings against the authorities of the country? Who in particular? Why?

Before praying: analyze your answers

Take your notebook and reread what you have just written in this section. Do not move on to the prayer before doing this work. Answer in writing:

1. What are the facts? What you really went through: the events, what happened, who did what.

2. What does all this tell you, bluntly, about what you are still carrying?

3. What do you feel when you think back on these facts: fear, mixed feelings, doubts, difficulty believing the Word of God?

4. What does the Word of God say on these points? Go back to what you declared in the identity prayer (exercise “My covering and my identity in Christ”): that is the reality.

5. Your conclusion: write in a few sentences what you discovered and what you want to settle once and for all.

Then pray from this conclusion. Do not just repeat the sentences of the prayer: name precisely what you discovered, and settle it with the Lord, once and for all.

Prayers A

Prayer 1 — Forgiving the people who offended you

Lord, the people here (name them) offended me in the following ways (describe the offense). It hurt me and I am still suffering from it. But I know that you went to the cross for them too. Today, by your grace and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit, I decide to forgive them. I know that this will not settle the wrong they did me. I accept to suffer from it and I forgive them. I also acknowledge my share of responsibility in the matter (describe your share of responsibility). I ask your forgiveness for it. Thank you for forgiving me and giving me the grace to forgive. I entrust myself to your care for the healing of my inner wound and for any possible restoration. In the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.

Prayer 2 — Forgiving political authorities (if applicable)

I have bitterness in my heart against (name the political authority). The reasons are the following (name them). I know that I am doing nothing good by feeding bitterness against them. Your word tells me not to fret because of one who prospers in his evil ways. Forgive me for disobeying you all this time. Help my heart in your way in the name of Jesus Christ. Besides, the authorities are under your control. I decide to obey you and to trust you. I free my heart from this bitterness and I forgive them by your strength in the name of Jesus Christ.

B. Bitterness against God

Answer honestly. These questions touch areas that many do not dare to express.

Answer in your personal notebook, before God alone. Nothing you write is saved in the application.

1. Have you prayed without getting an answer? Describe the situation.

2. Have you put your faith in God for a particular situation with the conviction that he had spoken to you, without success?

3. Have you suffered a bitter failure despite your faith, obedience, prayer, perseverance and diligence?

4. Do you feel a little as if God has deceived you? Are you angry with God?

Note: You are not going to forgive God — you must humble yourself under his hand. Whatever reasons you seem to have, humble yourself. You will understand in eternity.

Before praying: analyze your answers

Take your notebook and reread what you have just written in this section. Do not move on to the prayer before doing this work. Answer in writing:

1. What are the facts? What you really went through: the events, what happened, who did what.

2. What does all this tell you, bluntly, about what you are still carrying?

3. What do you feel when you think back on these facts: fear, mixed feelings, doubts, difficulty believing the Word of God?

4. What does the Word of God say on these points? Go back to what you declared in the identity prayer (exercise “My covering and my identity in Christ”): that is the reality.

5. Your conclusion: write in a few sentences what you discovered and what you want to settle once and for all.

Then pray from this conclusion. Do not just repeat the sentences of the prayer: name precisely what you discovered, and settle it with the Lord, once and for all.

Prayer B

Prayer of reconciliation with God

Lord God, I ask your forgiveness for drifting away from you because of what happened. (Describe the situation). Although I do not understand everything, I acknowledge that you are sovereign. I also know that you do everything out of love for me. And what is more, you work all things together for my good. Today I submit to your will.

I reject the devil’s lie that makes me believe you did me wrong. I also refuse to believe that you despise my faith. I also refuse to believe that you are unfaithful in fulfilling your promises. I believe the exact opposite. You are faithful, loving and sovereign. And you take care of me tenderly. Thank you for your love, Papa.

By your Holy Spirit, put my heart in order concerning this situation and give me faith for my future. I have prayed this in the name of Jesus Christ, my Lord and my Savior.

2. Have you had an intimate relationship with a person of the same sex as you?

3. Do you descend from an illicit relationship? (adultery, fornication, incest)

4. How many sexual partners have you had? Name them or designate them by a code:

5. Have you contracted a marriage in your dreams?

6. Have you committed or been an accomplice to an abortion?

7. Have you committed or been the victim of a rape?

8. List your gynecological problems (barrenness, miscarriage, cyst, menstrual cramps, frigidity, abundant white discharge, sexual weaknesses...)

9. Have you walked in on your parents during a sexual act?

The prayer

To be done aloud, using your answers.

Repent for having offended God by these sexual sins (fornication, adultery, incest, abortion... Be honest).

Ask that the blood of Jesus Christ wash you from all impurities coming from sexual perversions.

Declare: I receive the forgiveness of my Lord Jesus Christ by faith in his word.

In the name of Jesus Christ, I renounce sexuality with... (name all these former sexual partners. If you still have feelings for these people, tell God where you stand. Renounce sexuality with these people).

Let every sexual tie joining my spirit, my soul and my body with the spirit, soul and body of... be broken today in the name of Jesus Christ.

I proclaim my sexual freedom in the name of Jesus Christ.

I renounce every impure use of my body. I choose to live in chastity and purity, for my body is the temple of the Holy Spirit.

You, demon who has taken up residence in me because of my past mistakes, you no longer have the right to live in me. I command you to leave and never come back in the name of Jesus Christ.

Let every disorder of my sexuality be restored by the blood of Jesus Christ.

Night husband or night wife problem (if this concerns you)

Answer in your personal notebook, before God alone. Nothing you write is saved in the application.

1. Do you have a night husband or night wife problem? If so, since when?

4. Have you made a covenant with someone by promising them marriage?

Prayer against night spirits

Lord Jesus Christ, I thank you for the victory you won for me by your death on the cross and your resurrection.

I ask for and receive your forgiveness for (name these sexual or occult sins that preceded the beginning of your problem).

Blood of Jesus Christ, wash me and cleanse me from all dead works in the name of Jesus Christ.

I reject all enjoyment of evil in the name of Jesus Christ.

I renounce all marriage in the spiritual world.

By the blood of Jesus, I break every known or unknown covenant between me and this spirit in the name of Jesus Christ.

Christ saved me and transferred me from the kingdom of darkness to the light. Let my light shine in the name of Jesus Christ.

There is no fellowship between light and darkness; I put a definitive end to this evil contact by virtue of my Lord Jesus Christ’s victory on the cross.

Let my whole being be purged of every seed of these spirits by the precious blood of Jesus Christ.

Let my house be flooded with the blood of Jesus Christ.

Let every access for evil spirits in my life be closed by the blood of Jesus Christ.

Ties of rebellion are assaults that the devil launches against a life because of its resistance to its authorities. There are four authorities: the guardian (father/mother/tutor), the boss or teacher, the pastor or priest, the government. A woman is in addition subject to the authority of her husband.

The questions

Answer in your personal notebook, before God alone. Nothing you write is saved in the application.

1. Are you on good terms with your parents? Do you remember offending them? Did you really ask forgiveness?

2. Were you offended by one of your parents? Does it still hurt?

3. Have you arrogantly addressed or raised a hand against someone older than you?

4. Have you intentionally disobeyed your boss? Rejected the order of an authority?

5. Have you had a violent verbal exchange with an authority? What happened?

6. (Women) Are you submitted to your husband in the Lord? Do you refuse him his conjugal rights?

7. Do you respect the civil laws that are not against the Bible? Have you cursed political authorities?

Lord, I thank you for the grace that gives me access to freedom from all ties.

I ask your forgiveness for my thoughts, words and acts of rebellion.

Abnormal fear is an irrational, artificial dread created by the devil to trouble us and keep us in slavery. It takes two forms: fear of people and fear of misfortune/death.

The questions

Answer in your personal notebook, before God alone. Nothing you write is saved in the application.

1. Do you feel less important than others? Are you afraid of “what people will say”? Is there a person to whom you submit without thinking?

2. Do you often make commitments that you regret? Do you have difficulty saying no?

3. Are you afraid of dying? Constantly dizzy? Afraid that something serious will happen to you?

4. When something serious happens to someone, do you feel that you will be the next victim?

5. Do you hear voices that threaten misfortune or death? Do you see frightening things that no one else sees?

6. Are you afraid of the dark? Of emptiness? Frights in large rooms? Frequent nightmares? Do you wake up terrified?

7. Do you suffer from sleep paralysis?

8. Do you feel that your life will not improve?

Then pray from this conclusion. Do not just repeat the sentences of the prayer: name precisely what you discovered, and settle it with the Lord, once and for all.

The prayer

To be done aloud, using your answers.

Thank you, Lord, for your word, which is the truth and with which you regenerated me.

Today I reject the lies of the devil and I take your word, which is the truth.

I acknowledge that you are sovereign in this world and that I am under your protection and your blessing.

I know that whatever happens before me, I will always be victorious.

I now renounce all fear of people.

From now on I will defend my rights according to Christ and I will have the image of God in me respected.

I renounce the fear of misfortune, of death, of emptiness, of the dark... God has given me a spirit of power and love.

By the Holy Spirit in me, I reject and drive out every spirit of fear in the name of Jesus Christ.

I break the fear of... (name one by one all the phobias you have) and I reject it in the name of Jesus Christ.

My protection, my present, my future and everything that is mine is in the hands of the Lord Jesus Christ.

I am free from fear. I fear my God alone.

I refuse the devil’s lies about my future. I believe in God. He takes care of me. All is well and will always be well, in the name of Jesus Christ my Savior and Lord.

Love of the world is enmity against God. The 3 great traits are: the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, the pride of life (1 John 2:15-17).

The things that bind me

Answer in your personal notebook, before God alone. Nothing you write is saved in the application.

List the things that bind you from this list (add those that are not mentioned):

Theft • quarrels • lies • fights • complaints • criticism • covetousness/envy • slander • insults • laziness • hatred of others • anger • alcohol • love of money • malice toward others • fornication • masturbation • pornography • adultery • pride • contempt for others

1. Are you often anxious? Do you spend excessively, so that when you have no money you are stressed?

2. Do you eat too much? Do you insist on eating expensive food? Do you spend a lot on clothes?

3. Do you have difficulty giving to help others? For the works of God? Do you forget to give the tithe?

4. Do you take pride in your race, tribe, family line or social rank?

5. Can you stay in a group where a woman is the leader? Where a person younger or less well-off than you is the leader?

6. Do you have difficulty forgiving? Are you vengeful? Do you insist that people apologize to you?

7. Do you easily acknowledge your faults?

8. Do you talk a lot about your good deeds and exploits?

Lord Jesus Christ, I thank you for the salvation you gave me through your death and resurrection. Thank you for this free gift. I accept your grace.

I am not of the world, I am Christ’s, a citizen of heaven, a member of God’s family, beloved and blessed.

I reject the world and these things. I reject the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes and the pride of life.
